source: Fujimi TDnet: Revisions of Financial Forecast and Dividend Forecast (10-09-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Fujimi revised its May 14, 2026 forecasts upward to reflect better-than-expected results for the six months ended September 30, 2026, primarily driven by firm demand for its products for CMP and silicon wafers. First six months of FY2027 (April-September 2026): net sales JPY 40,500 million (previous forecast JPY 36,200 million, +11.9%), operating profit JPY 9,050 million (previous JPY 7,450 million, +21.5%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 6,750 million (previous JPY 5,500 million). Full FY2027 (April 2026-March 2027): net sales JPY 82,500 million (previous JPY 74,800 million, +10.3%), operating profit JPY 17,250 million (previous JPY 14,500 million, +19.0%), ordinary profit JPY 17,150 million, profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 12,600 million (previous JPY 10,400 million); FY2026 actual net sales were JPY 69,404 million.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2027 net sales JPY 82,500 million (from JPY 74,800 million, +10.3%); operating profit JPY 17,250 million (+19.0%); H1 net sales JPY 40,500 million (+11.9% vs previous forecast)
